name: BoB Keen Black 24H Pencil Gel Eyeliner / Kajal
description:
BoB Keen Black 24H Pencil Gel Eyeliner / Kajal

Description:
Achieve bold and captivating eyes with the BoB Keen Black 24H Pencil Gel Eyeliner / Kajal. Its super-sharp black formula enriched with carbon black intensifies lash color, enhances volume, and creates a beautiful curl for a striking look.

Key Features:

Long-Lasting: 24-hour wear for all-day confidence.

Waterproof & Oil-Resistant: Smudge-proof formula keeps eyes flawless.

Enhances Eyelashes: Deepens lash color and adds volume.

Easy Application: Smooth pencil glides effortlessly for precise lining.

Made in China

Create mesmerizing, bold eyes that stay flawless from morning to night.
